# `product`

Area: **inventory** ([all tables](README.md))

SID Product (TMF637 product): an instance of an offering on a billing account. Written only by orders; billable on start_date <= d < termination_date.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Primary key, generated by the database (gen_random_uuid()). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | When the row was inserted: the database's now(), not the injected clock. Never used for billing decisions. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Last change: the database's now(), maintained by the set_updated_at trigger. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `product_offering_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The offering the product was created with; later ones in product_offering_change. |
| `status` | `product_status_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | TMF637 status. Cosmetic for money (billing is driven by dates); flipped by the worker: created -> active, pendingTerminate -> terminated. cancelled and aborted are never billed. |
| `start_date` | `date` | no |  | TMF637 startDate: the first billable day (a business date in BILLING_TZ). |
| `termination_date` | `date` | yes |  | TMF637 terminationDate, exclusive: the first day no longer billed. NULL = open-ended. Immutable once set (a product is deleted once). |
| `created_by_item_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The add order item that created the product (TMF637 productOrderItem, role creation). |
| `terminated_by_item_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The delete order item that terminated or cancelled the product (role termination); NULL while open. |
| `base_type` | `text` | yes |  | TMF @baseType as the client sent it (the super-class when sub-classing). |
| `schema_location` | `text` | yes |  | TMF @schemaLocation as the client sent it (a JSON Schema URI). |
| `name` | `text` | no |  | TMF637 name: the product's own; by default its offering's name at creation. |
| `details` | `jsonb` | no | `'{}'::jsonb` | TMF637 descriptive attributes as sent, validated against the spec; billing never reads them. |
| `requires_msisdn` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Built-in msisdn requirement at ordering; existing products remain unchecked. |
| `manually_suspended` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Operator suspension independent of prepaid funded coverage and account state. |
| `requires_imsi` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Built-in imsi requirement at ordering; existing products remain unchecked. |
| `parent_product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | An add-on pack's plan product (TMF637 productRelationship, type addOn); the add-on ends with the plan's paid period. |
| `grantless` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Prepaid: an add-on or pay-as-you-go product. Active between its dates with no funded interval, never renewed; the order that created it completes it. |
| `lifecycle_suspended` | `boolean` | no | `false` | The status timeline's suspension was taken by the prepaid lifecycle (manually_suspended is then true as well); it does not block renewal. |
